item.title: Fact or Fiction: Melania Trump documentary to be mandatory in history courses?
item.description: An image going around appears to show a post from President Trump announcing the new documentary about First Lady Melania Trump will now be mandatory viewing in all school and college history courses.

item.title: Almost half of San Diego Community College District's 2025 applications were 'ghost students'
item.description: They’re called ghost students, and no, we’re not talking about haunted school hallways. We're talking about scammers.
